title: 第11章 血火刺第12章 逆子
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
“看好了。”
李天命的速度猛然提升，在这无形之间，他的双腿如同幻影，速度非常快，直接带给李紫峰鬼魅缠身的感觉。
这是‘高品兽级战诀’——鬼影步，这几乎是兽级战诀之中最顶尖的步法，李天命曾经磨炼过小半年。
一道鬼影闪过，如有噩梦相随。
嗡！
在李紫峰头皮发麻的时刻，李天命陡然出现在其眼前。
龙象重拳！
这一门拳法战诀，可以说是李天命的招牌，他曾经的伴生兽是金属性的四翼金翅大鹏鸟，拥有可怕的速度和力量，这一门高品兽级战诀‘龙象重拳’就是为他设计的一种极端拳法。
这一拳，如同有龙象附体，可以打出最恐怖的力量，而且还携带着高频度的震荡，据说这重拳打出，能直接把人五脏六腑都震碎。
如今的李天命没有龙象的力量，但却有比龙象更加恐怖的太古混沌巨兽之力！
最关键的是，这一拳是由带着手套的黑暗手臂打出来的，其拳力在震荡的时刻，感觉就比以前凶猛很多！
超绝的速度，逆天的重拳，此刻汇聚在一起，简直迅猛刚硬，一拳爆出，直指李紫峰！
李紫峰已经感受到了这一拳的威力，他眯着眼睛，镇定施展一招高品兽级战诀‘炎云掌法’硬对。
这炎云掌法还不错，掌影之间形成一层火焰云雾，可以防御迷惑，也可以镇压，火焰云雾之中，一掌威力潜藏其中，爆发出来足以震动山河。
“回光返照，野狗挣扎，徒增笑柄！”
李紫峰凛然无惧，他对自己的深厚兽元有着极端自信。
轰！
下一个瞬间，拳掌相对！
人们听到一声闷响，再听得咔嚓一声，最后听到一声惨叫，他们定睛一看，李紫峰整个人飞了出去！
砰！

李紫峰的脑袋狠狠的撞在地上，哐当一声，头晕目眩，鼻血都飙了出来。
最可怕的是，他的一条胳膊，几乎都扭曲了，手指头全是血，痛得他龇牙咧嘴。
“李天命！”
李紫峰抬头一看，此刻全场死寂，他就知道自己有多丢人了。
这样的一幕，直接给整个城主府带来地震！
那听风楼上，原本还坐着的人很多都哗然起立，他们瞪大眼睛看着听风台，脸上都是难以置信的神色。
“这怎么可能？李天命的兽元不是据说快流失干净了！”
“这都三年了，任何御兽师都彻底废掉了！”
“紫峰可是兽脉境第七重。”
“是不是李天命用了什么见不得人的手段！”
莫夫人脸色非常难看。
这个被当做是离火城污点的人，在所有人都认为他马上就要销声匿迹，从此烟消云散的时刻，他竟然回来了，而且真正展现出了能和李紫峰对抗的实力！
原来他今天上场，真不是开玩笑！
恐怕只有黄夫人撇撇嘴了，因为她见识过李天命之前的爆发。
李雪娇同样目瞪口呆，她是想借助二哥的手教训李天命，现在是谁教训谁呢？
content_en:
"Watch it."
Li Tianming's speed suddenly increased. Invisibly, his legs were like phantoms, and his speed was very fast, which directly gave Li Zifeng the feeling of being haunted by a ghost.
This is the 'high-grade beast-level combat technique' - Ghost Shadow Step. This is almost the top footwork among beast-level combat techniques. Li Tianming has been practicing it for half a year.
A ghostly shadow flashed past, as if accompanied by a nightmare.
Buzz!
When Li Zifeng's scalp was numb, Li Tianming suddenly appeared in front of him.
Dragon Elephant punches hard!
This boxing technique can be said to be Li Tianming's signature. His former companion beast was a metallic four-winged golden roc bird with terrifying speed and power. This high-grade beast-level fighting technique, 'Dragon Elephant Heavy Fist', is an extreme boxing technique designed for him.
This punch is like being possessed by a dragon and elephant, it can produce the most terrifying power, and it also carries high-frequency shocks. It is said that this heavy punch can directly shatter a person's internal organs.
Today's Li Tianming does not have the power of the dragon elephant, but he has the power of the ancient chaotic beast that is more terrifying than the dragon elephant!
The most important thing is that this punch was made by a dark arm wearing a glove. When the power of the punch was shaking, it felt much more fierce than before!
Super speed and heaven-defying punches came together at this moment. They were so fast and hard that they burst out with one punch, pointing directly at Li Zifeng!
Li Zifeng had already felt the power of this punch. He squinted his eyes and calmly used a high-grade beast-level combat technique, the 'Fire Cloud Palm Technique' to fight hard.
This Yanyun palm technique is not bad. A layer of flame cloud is formed between the palm shadows, which can be used to defend against confusion and suppress it. In the flame cloud, the power of a palm is hidden, and when it explodes, it can shake the mountains and rivers.
"In retrospect, wild dogs struggle, which only adds to the laughing stock!"
Li Zifeng is fearless and extremely confident in his profound beast essence.
boom!
The next moment, fists and palms faced each other!
People heard a muffled sound, then a click, and finally a scream. They took a closer look and saw Li Zifeng flying out!
Bang!
Li Zifeng's head hit the ground hard with a clang, making him dizzy and causing nosebleeds.
The most terrifying thing was that one of his arms was almost twisted, his fingers were covered in blood, and he grimaced in pain.
"Li Tianming!"
Li Zifeng looked up and saw that the whole place was dead silent. He knew how embarrassed he was.
Such a scene directly caused an earthquake to the entire city lord's palace!
On the Tingfeng Tower, many people who were still sitting stood up in an uproar. They looked at the Tingfeng Tower with wide eyes, with expressions of disbelief on their faces.
"How is this possible? Isn't it said that Li Tianming's beast essence is about to be lost!"
"It's been three years, any beast master has been completely useless!"
"Zifeng is at the seventh level of the beast vein realm."
"Did Li Tianming use some shameful means?"
Mrs. Mo's face was very ugly.
This person who was regarded as a stain on Lihuo City, at the moment when everyone thought he was about to disappear and disappear, he actually came back and truly showed his strength to fight against Li Zifeng!
It turns out he was really not joking when he played today!
I'm afraid only Mrs. Huang curled her lips because she had seen Li Tianming's previous outbursts.
Li Xuejiao was also stunned. She wanted to teach Li Tianming a lesson with the help of her second brother. Who is going to teach whom now?
